description: gnomAD v4 and 1000 Genomes ancestry distribution, homozygote counts and in-silico predictions for SLC40A1 Q248H, plus ClinVar classification
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
q="""{ variant(variantId:"2-189565370-C-A", dataset: gnomad_r4){
 exome{ac an af homozygote_count populations{id ac an homozygote_count}}
 genome{ac an af homozygote_count populations{id ac an homozygote_count}}
 in_silico_predictors{id value flags}
 transcript_consequences{gene_symbol hgvsc hgvsp major_consequence lof polyphen_prediction sift_prediction}
} }"""
g=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":q},timeout=60).json()["data"]["variant"]
print("exome hom:",g["exome"]["homozygote_count"],"genome hom:",g["genome"]["homozygote_count"])
afr_e=[p for p in g["exome"]["populations"] if p["id"]=="afr"][0]
afr_g=[p for p in g["genome"]["populations"] if p["id"]=="afr"][0]
print("exome AFR:",afr_e,"\ngenome AFR:",afr_g)
print("in silico:",g["in_silico_predictors"])
tc=[t for t in g["transcript_consequences"] if t["gene_symbol"]=="SLC40A1"][:2]
for t in tc: print("consequence:",t)

# ClinVar via E-utilities
eu="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils"
ids=requests.get(f"{eu}/esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":"rs11568350[VARIANT ID] OR SLC40A1[gene] AND Q248H","retmode":"json","retmax":5},timeout=30).json()
print("\nclinvar esearch:",ids["esearchresult"].get("idlist"))
if ids["esearchresult"].get("idlist"):
    s=requests.get(f"{eu}/esummary.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids["esearchresult"]["idlist"]),"retmode":"json"},timeout=30).json()
    for k,v in s["result"].items():
        if k=="uids": continue
        print(" ", v.get("title"), "|", v.get("germline_classification",{}).get("description"),
              "| review:", v.get("germline_classification",{}).get("review_status"))

# --- Figure: gnomAD/1000G ancestry distribution of Q248H ---
rows=[("gnomAD v4 African/African-American (exomes)",0.05141,33476),
      ("gnomAD v4 African/African-American (genomes)",0.05070,41584),
      ("1000G ASW (African ancestry SW USA)",0.07377,122),
      ("1000G ESN (Esan, Nigeria)",0.06566,198),
      ("1000G GWD (Gambian)",0.05752,226),
      ("1000G ACB (Afro-Caribbean)",0.04688,192),
      ("1000G YRI (Yoruba, Nigeria)",0.04630,216),
      ("1000G MSL (Mende, Sierra Leone)",0.02941,170),
      ("1000G LWK (Luhya, Kenya)",0.02525,198),
      ("HGDP Bantu South Africa",0.25,16),
      ("HGDP Mandenka",0.075,40),
      ("gnomAD Admixed American",0.00239,44724),
      ("gnomAD Middle Eastern",0.00104,5768),
      ("gnomAD European (non-Finnish)",0.0,1111959),
      ("gnomAD East Asian",0.0,39700),
      ("gnomAD South Asian",0.0,4830),
      ("gnomAD Finnish",0.0,53416),
      ("gnomAD Ashkenazi Jewish",0.0,26136)]
import pandas as pd
d=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["pop","af","an"]).sort_values("af")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,6.5))
c=["#9d0208" if "African" in p or any(x in p for x in ["ASW","ESN","GWD","ACB","YRI","MSL","LWK","Bantu","Mandenka"]) else "#6c757d" for p in d["pop"]]
ax.barh(d["pop"],d.af*100,color=c,alpha=.88)
for y,(af,an) in enumerate(zip(d.af,d.an)):
    ax.text(af*100+0.3,y,f"{af*100:.2f}%  (AN={an:,})",va='center',fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlabel("SLC40A1 p.Gln248His (rs11568350, 2-189565370-C-A) allele frequency, %")
ax.set_title("Q248H is restricted to African ancestry: 5.1% in gnomAD v4 AFR,\n0 of 1,111,959 non-Finnish European alleles",fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlim(0,30); ax.grid(axis='x',alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
